questions: Review cards (#399's measure): how many ◈ Narrative Review cards does the audit post, on which kinds, and is any of them false — a closing offer line read as the move made, a cutaway held to where the characters are, a line the code already held, a kind outside the audit's measured set?

The judge's re-asks (#399's measure): how many judge calls run, on which kinds, and how many re-asks do they cause? Is every re-ask on a kind the measure passed ([cost], [fight], [foe], [oracle], [premise], [price], [unsaid], [whereabouts]), and was each right?
Answered once (#399's measure): does the runner's answered-once check stay clean — no line narrated twice, no review card counted as a narration?
The judge's cutoff (N7): does any judge call time out at 4 s, and does its request stop there rather than run on in the API Log?

Redrafts (N9, N10): when a narration is written again, is the redraft ever not posted because it broke a line the first draft kept? After a code re-ask, is the posted draft judged, and what did that verdict find?
The GM's note (N16): does any narration still break a line after its re-ask, and is a GM-only Narrative Review note posted for it, once, after its card? Was each note right?
Set-pieces (N29): do the oath scene, any clock vignette and the opening call Mira "you" and use no table words; is any asked again, and what for?
The offer line (N32): is every closing move suggestion recognised (the Roll button names the move it invites), and is any narration not offered a move read with its closing italic line?
Harm with no cost (D9): does any narration tell harm, a wound or a spent resource the sheet never took, and was each caught in code or left?
The fight: between Enter the Fray and Take Decisive Action, is the foe ever told destroyed, dead, fled or beaten, and what did the [foe] judge rule?
Where Mira is: does a frame, a recap or STANDING NOW ever place her somewhere a later frame had moved her from, and does anyone appear in person where the record has them elsewhere?
Repetition: is any line of speech of six words or more said twice, and how does the refrain count compare with round 9's?
What it cost: calls, dollars and seconds a line against round 9 (469 calls, $3.26), with the judge and the audit on; beats done and checks violated against round 9.

prices.notes: Standard rates, read from Anthropic's price list on the date above. A cache write is charged at 1.25 times input when it is kept five minutes and twice input when it is kept an hour, by the split the response reports (lib/budget.mjs); a write that does not say is priced as an hour's. Haiku 5.5 costs five times these rates on a prompt over 100,000 tokens; the module's prompts are a few thousand.
